rationale: The massing reads as a coherent low podium with a smaller upper bar, so the main/support relationship is understandable in all views. It is not depending on stepback/stair massing; instead it uses a simple stacked extrusion with a clear anchor. However, the form has very little void or undercut logic, so it feels mostly solid rather than publicly porous. The geometry appears stable and not visibly self-colliding across views, with no strong signs of over-clipping. Precedent resonance is moderate because it echoes podium-plus-tower and slender bar references, but it is far less expressive than the torqued/undercut precedents.
warnings: Limited public void or courtyard formation.
Upper mass is modest and could read as only a shallow cap if pushed further.
The silhouette is coherent but somewhat generic for a taper family.
